diagrams.caption: Fig. PD-1 Cross-sectional view of propeller shaft

measurements_and_specs: L: 565 mm (22.24 in) for HLS30 (2 seater)

diagrams.caption: Fig. PD-2 Cross-sectional view of differential carrier

diagrams.caption: Fig. PD-3 Holding differential carrier
diagrams.description: Differential carrier clamped onto Gear Carrier Attachment KV38100800.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Mount carrier on Gear Carrier Attachment KV38100800 before removing rear cover.

diagrams.caption: Fig. PD-4 Removing side bearing outer race
diagrams.description: Extracting side bearing outer race from side retainer using puller ST33290001.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Extract bearing outer race from side retainer using puller ST33290001.

diagrams.caption: Fig. PD-5 Removing drive pinion nut
diagrams.description: Loosening drive pinion nut using flange wrench ST31530000 on companion flange.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Hold companion flange with wrench ST31530000 while loosening nut.

diagrams.caption: Fig. PD-6 Removing pinion rear bearing inner race

diagrams.mechanic_notes: Extract from drive pinion with a press.

diagrams.caption: Fig. PD-7 Removing side bearing

diagrams.caption: Fig. PD-8 Measuring clearance

measurements_and_specs: Normal backlash or clearance: 0.1 to 0.2 mm (0.004 to 0.008 in)

diagrams.caption: Fig. PD-9 Tapping bolt head
diagrams.description: Tapping bolt heads lightly with hammer while tightening in criss-cross pattern.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Tighten bolts in criss-cross fashion lightly tapping around bolt heads with a hammer.

diagrams.caption: Fig. PD-10 Measuring bearing width
diagrams.description: Measuring side bearing width with Master Gauge KV38101900 and Weight Block ST32501000 under a dial indicator.
measurements_and_specs: Standard bearing width: 20.00 mm (0.7874 in)

diagrams.caption: Fig. PD-11 Installing side bearing cone

diagrams.mechanic_notes: Tighten drive pinion nut to specified torque using Stopper ST31852000.

diagrams.caption: Fig. PD-14 Measuring the clearance

diagrams.caption: Fig. PD-15 Adjusting pinion height

diagrams.mechanic_notes: Measure clearance N between tip end of height gauge and end surface of dummy shaft.

troubleshooting.probable_cause: Loose propeller shaft installation
Dust cover on sleeve yoke rubbing on transmission rear extension. Dust cover on companion flange rubbing on differential carrier.
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Straighten dust cover to remove interference.

troubleshooting.probable_cause: Shortage of oil
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Supply gear oil. Rebuild gear carrier if necessary.

troubleshooting.probable_cause: Incorrect tooth contact between ring gear and drive pinion
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Adjust tooth contact or replace the hypoid gear set.

troubleshooting.probable_cause: Incorrect backlash between ring gear and drive pinion
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Adjust backlash or replace the hypoid gear set if necessary.

troubleshooting.probable_cause: Seized or damaged ring gear and drive pinion
Seized, damaged or broken drive pinion bearing
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Replace the pinion bearing and faulty parts.

troubleshooting.probable_cause: Seized, damaged or broken side bearing
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Replace the side bearing and faulty parts.

troubleshooting.probable_cause: Loose bolts or nuts fixing ring gear, side bearing caps, etc.
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Tighten to specified torque, and replace faulty parts.

troubleshooting.probable_cause: Seized, damaged or broken side and pinion gears
Seized, damaged or broken side gear and pinion thrust washer
Pinion gears too tight on their shaft
Interference between side flange and differential case
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Repair the part responsible for interference, or replace the side flange and differential case.

troubleshooting.symptom: Knocking sound during starting or gear shifting
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Excessive backlash (ring gear-to-drive pinion or side gear-to-pinion gear)

troubleshooting.symptom: Knocking sound during starting or gear shifting
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Worn gears or case

troubleshooting.symptom: Knocking sound during starting or gear shifting
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Worn side flange and side gear spline

troubleshooting.symptom: Knocking sound during starting or gear shifting
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Pinion bearing under preload

troubleshooting.symptom: Knocking sound during starting or gear shifting
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Loose drive pinion nut

troubleshooting.symptom: Knocking sound during starting or gear shifting
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Loose bolts or nuts fixing ring gear, side bearing caps, etc.
Shortage of oil or use of unsuitable oil
Excessively small backlash
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Adjust backlash and replace as required.

troubleshooting.probable_cause: Incorrect adjustment of bearings or gears
Severe service due to excessive loading, improper use of clutch
Loose bolts and nuts, such as ring gear bolts
Worn-out, damaged or improperly driven front oil seal, or bruised, dented or abnormally worn slide face of companion flange
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Replace the faulty oil seal. Amend the affected flange with sandpaper or replace if necessary.

troubleshooting.probable_cause: Worn, damaged or improperly driven side oil seal, or bruised, dented or abnormally worn slide flange
Loose rear cover bolts
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Tighten the bolts to specified torque.

troubleshooting.probable_cause: Worn rear cover gasket
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Replace the faulty gasket with new one.

troubleshooting.probable_cause: Loose filler or drain plug
Clogged or damaged breather
